messages:
perf-bot: alert: ingress-host p95 latency +90ms (1m window) for canary group kernel-hinter=aggressive at 11:22 UTC
Priya: noticed this too — tail is all host-side. traces show repeated 2–3 token flushes causing tiny frames out.
Tom: packet capture from a canary host: stream has many 60–140B payload frames, TCP push per token. write syscall count is through the roof.
Luis: CPU profile: tokenizer threads spending time in `utf8_normalize` and mutex wait; packetizer shows high `sendmsg` syscalls.
Anya: KV stats: working set churn increased, per-shard hotset growth -> eviction spikes. hit_rate fell 0.91 -> 0.68 on canary.
Priya: recent config diffs: aggressive kernel hint landed with narrower-kernel bias at 11:20 and batcher heuristic tweak (favor latency) at 11:18. I think combination produced many short outputs and smaller batching windows.
Tom: replicated in a local replay: when kernel bias -> narrow kernels, output token bursts become more bursty leading to micro-frames. Batcher latency favors caused broker to flush sooner. p95 +84ms.
Luis: perf numbers from replay:
```
baseline: write syscalls 160/s | tokenize CPU 22% | packetizer syscalls 45/s
canary: write syscalls 480/s | tokenize CPU 58% | packetizer syscalls 138/s
```
Anya: KV: evictions per min baseline 12 -> canary 47. Also IO pressure on shard logs increased.
Priya: short-term mitigations to try now:
- flip kernel-hinter back to conservative
- restore batcher-window to previous heuristics (favor size over immediate latency)
- enable coalescing fallback in stream-writer (software grouping of frames)
- temporarily raise KV cache watermark to delay evictions
Tom: I can push a stream-writer coalesce patch to canary in 20m — it's a non-invasive fallback.
Luis: I'll roll back batcher heuristic and prepare a safe revert for kernel-hinter.
Anya: I'll bump cache watermark and watch eviction and hit-rate. Also adding an alert rule: hit_rate drop >15% in 2m to pager.
Priya: test results: coalescer on a local replay reduced write syscalls by ~70% and reduced p95 by ~63ms.
Tom: coalescer deployed to canary at 11:46 UTC. early telemetry: write syscalls down 60%, packetizer CPU down ~40%.
Luis: batcher revert PR merged and kernel-hinter toggled to conservative at 11:49. deploy-bot: configs flipped.
Anya: KV watermark increased on canary at 11:50; eviction rate falling back toward baseline.
Priya: closing note: root cause is interaction between kernel selection (more small outputs) and batching heuristic (flush-early) exposing packetizer write overhead and tokenizer contention; KV thrash amplified tail. Longer-term actions: microframe-aware kernel tuning, add micro-bench for flush patterns, default coalescing in stream-writer, KV adaptive shard sizing.
Tom: will add unit + e2e test that simulates token-burst small-frame patterns.
Luis: will instrument tokenizer pool mutex timings and add metrics to dashboards.
Anya: will add a recovery playbook and automated rollback for kernel-hint toggles.
Priya: thanks all — thread for the follow-up postmortem. :white_check_mark:
